enchantment.antarchy.chronosphere.desc: Creates a time-dilation field around the wearer; higher levels increase its radius.
Amplifies damage when striking a target from behind.
enchantment.forbidden_arcanus.soul_looti: Grants a 5% chance per level for a slain entity to spawn a Lost Soul.
enchantment.netherexp.longshot.desc: Improves a shotgun's effectiveness at long range.
enchantment.netherexp.volley.desc: Adds more pellets to each shotgun blast, but increases the weapon's cooldown.
